text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a stroll downtown on my day off, I
run into Ines Fujin. She usually buries
herself in part-time gigs outside of
training, so I'm surprised to see her out
and about.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer! Yep! It's my day off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't get to go out often, so I gotta
make it count! It's just a matter
of deciding
where to start!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or at least... that's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's just... I can whip up ideas to kill some time, but for a whole day?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's weird—I'm drawing a complete
blank!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her hectic lifestyle,
I can't say
I'm surprised. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! Guess I'll take you up on
that offer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, where will you take me first? Hehe,
I'm counting on you for a
super fun time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Awww! The cranes and koalas are sooo
cuuuuute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The local zoo back home doesn't even
come close to this one! I'm sure
my sisters
will love it here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to take her day up another notch,
I whip out my phone to check online for
the must-see attractions. However, when I
look at the
zoo map...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Really? Let me check. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Seems like it got moved last week. It's on
the other side of the
penguin habitat now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wooooow! The view's amaaazing! I bet if
we use that telescope, we
can see the
school from here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make a beeline to the telescope next to
Ines Fujin, eager to slide a
coin in. But...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oof! I think the change machine was over
there somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, slow down! The telescope isn't
going anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
I feel like a real high roller here...
It's giving me butterflies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hold on, hold on! There's a warning
sign here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you need special coins to
play. Let's head to the
exchange machine
first, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we bounce from place to place.
However, every single
time, I find myself
relying on Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! Yeah, you
made a few mistakes, but it
wasn't all that
bad.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I got to try out a bunch of new things,
and
I could tell you really did
your best.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Honestly, it made me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I want to do better—I want
her to know she can
depend on me. But at
this rate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Actually,
I still have one more place up
my sleeve that I'm sure she'll
absolutely
love.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Woooo!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! That runner's not slowing down
at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're on the edge of our seats watching
the race—Ines Fujin's eyes
locked onto the
blazing front runner.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters on turf... That's the same
distance as the Japanese
Derby, and she
smoked everyone like it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's also the same distance as the
race I
first saw her run in—the
one that reeled me
in, hook, line, and sinker.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You really think I can do it? Actually, yeah... I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure of it now—
I just looove the thrill
of leading the pack!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run full speed and rip through the
turf faster than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wild beast within her awakens,
sparking fire in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—the crowd going wild as she
crosses the finish line, all
chanting her
name. The day her dream comes true.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
That's what being a front runner
is all about!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, one of the runners just now fell
behind because of a bad start.
We gotta
watch out for that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There's also the risk of getting
blocked or
running out of gas...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Wow, Trainer's really chatty now. I can
feel the excitement and
passion... It's
kinda like...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our talk continues from there, and before
I know it, we've been
discussing training
methods and strategies for hours.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I gotta say... You really picked the right career.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't trying to be sarcastic or
anything!
In fact, I reeeally
appreciate your
dedication!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And I gotta admit, you sounded pretty
cool!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So no need to apologize, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch for today! I'd love to hang
out again if we get the
chance!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep! Looking forward to it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, our day ends with a smile on Ines
Fujin's lips. Despite a few
hiccups, I'd say
we managed to make the most of her rare
day off!
